sentences.text: Mcrc No. 3775 of 2024

Bihari Lal Yadav S/o Late Rajkumar Yadav, Aged About 31 Years R/o
Village- Parpatiya Pipariya, P.S. Kamleshwarpur, District Sarguja
(C.G.)
 ---- Applicant
 Versus
State Of Chhattisgarh Through Station House Officer,
Kamleshwarpur, District Sarguja (C.G.)
 ---- Respondent

For Applicant : Mr. Shikar Agnihotri, Advocate For State : Mr. Anmol Sharma, Panel Lawyer S.B.:
Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge Order On Board 15/06/2024
1.

Applicant has filed this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail as he was
arrested in connection with Crime No.40/2023 registered at Police Station -Kamleshwarpur,
District- Sarguja (Cg) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 450 of Ipc.
2.

Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that victim lodged report in the concerned police station alleging that on 27.06.2023 when she was alone in her house and sleeping in the afternoon,
applicant entered into the house, committed forceful sexual intercourse with her.
The incident was informed to her husband in the evening when he returned back to his house.

Based on the report,
aforementioned crime was registered and the applicant was arrested.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime.
He has not committed any offence as alleged against him.
Victim is a major married lady.
She has now been examined before the trial Court and has not supported the case of prosecution.
Her husband also not supported the case of prosecution.
Hence, the applicant may be released on regular bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the submission of learned counsel for the applicant.
He submits that deposition which is relied upon by learned counsel for the applicant is subject matter of appreciation by the trial Court.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text:
Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation,
submission of learned counsel for the applicant based on deposition of victim and her husband,
without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow the bail application.
7. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail on his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one local surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that:-
a) Applicant shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) Applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Certified copy as per rules.
